PRE:
PicLan-IP/BASIC ^ ^
INCLUDE PLBASIC BP.INCLUDES PLW.INCLUDES
OPEN 'XMLDATA' TO XMLDATAF ELSE STOP 201,'XMLDATA' OPEN 'SO' TO SOF ELSE STOP 201,'SO' HAS.CUSTF = 1 OPEN 'CUSTOMER' TO CUSTOMERF ELSE HAS.CUSTF = 0
CRLF = CHAR(13):CHAR(10) XVM = CHAR(253)
* GET_PENDING_SO_FAST.XML - List open SOs with pagination + search * Uses SSELECT WITH 15 NE to pre-filter closed SOs at D3 level * Supports: limit, offset, customer_search
PL_ADD_HDR '"Content-Type: application/xml"' PL_ADD_HDR '"Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"'
XML.RESPONSE = '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : CRLF SCRIPT_VERSION = '2026-02-25-F6-PERFORMANCE-FIX'
* Parse parameters PL_GETVAR LIMIT.PARAM FROM 'limit' ELSE LIMIT.PARAM = '50' IF NUM(LIMIT.PARAM) THEN MAX_RESULTS = LIMIT.PARAM ELSE MAX_RESULTS = 50 IF MAX_RESULTS < 1 THEN MAX_RESULTS = 1 IF MAX_RESULTS > 200 THEN MAX_RESULTS = 200
PL_GETVAR OFFSET.PARAM FROM 'offset' ELSE OFFSET.PARAM = '0' IF NUM(OFFSET.PARAM) THEN OFFSET = OFFSET.PARAM ELSE OFFSET = 0 IF OFFSET < 0 THEN OFFSET = 0
PL_GETVAR CUSTOMER.SEARCH FROM 'customer_search' ELSE CUSTOMER.SEARCH = '' CUSTOMER.SEARCH = TRIM(CUSTOMER.SEARCH) SEARCH.NORM = '' IF CUSTOMER.SEARCH NE '' THEN SEARCH.NORM = OCONV(CUSTOMER.SEARCH, 'MCU')
* SSELECT pre-filters closed SOs at D3 level SL = 'SSELECT SO WITH 15 NE "C" AND WITH 15 NE "CM"' EXECUTE SL
CNT = 0 MATCHED = 0 HAS_MORE = 'N' TOTAL_SELECTED = 0 STATUS_SKIP_COUNT = 0 SEARCH_SKIP_COUNT = 0
LOOP READNEXT SO_ID ELSE EXIT TOTAL_SELECTED = TOTAL_SELECTED + 1 SO_ID = TRIM(SO_ID) IF SO_ID = '' THEN CONTINUE
READ SO.REC FROM SOF, SO_ID ELSE CONTINUE
* Get Ship-To code SHIPTO_CODE = SO.REC<4> IF SHIPTO_CODE = '' THEN SHIPTO_CODE = SO.REC<2>
* Customer search filter - ONLY read CUSTOMER when actively searching SHIPTO_NAME = '' CREDIT_HOLD = 'N' IF SEARCH.NORM NE '' THEN * Read CUSTOMER only when search is active (performance optimization) IF SHIPTO_CODE NE '' AND HAS.CUSTF THEN READ CUST.REC FROM CUSTOMERF, SHIPTO_CODE ELSE CUST.REC = '' IF CUST.REC NE '' THEN SHIPTO_NAME = CUST.REC<1> CONVERT XVM TO '' IN SHIPTO_NAME CONVERT CHAR(252) TO '' IN SHIPTO_NAME END END IF SHIPTO_NAME = '' THEN SHIPTO_NAME = SHIPTO_CODE
* Apply search filter SHIPTO_NAME.NORM = OCONV(SHIPTO_NAME, 'MCU') SHIPTO_CODE.NORM = OCONV(SHIPTO_CODE, 'MCU') SO_ID.NORM = OCONV(SO_ID, 'MCU') IF INDEX(SHIPTO_NAME.NORM, SEARCH.NORM, 1) = 0 AND INDEX(SHIPTO_CODE.NORM, SEARCH.NORM, 1) = 0 AND INDEX(SO_ID.NORM, SEARCH.NORM, 1) = 0 THEN SEARCH_SKIP_COUNT = SEARCH_SKIP_COUNT + 1 CONTINUE END END ELSE * No search active - use shipto_code as name for speed SHIPTO_NAME = SHIPTO_CODE END
* Pagination offset IF MATCHED < OFFSET THEN MATCHED = MATCHED + 1 CONTINUE END
MATCHED = MATCHED + 1
* Early exit: stop as soon as we have enough AFTER FILTERING IF CNT >= MAX_RESULTS THEN HAS_MORE = 'Y' EXIT END
CNT = CNT + 1
* Get SO date SO_DATE_RAW = SO.REC<1> IF NUM(SO_DATE_RAW) AND SO_DATE_RAW > 0 THEN SO_DATE_FMT = OCONV(SO_DATE_RAW, 'D2/') END ELSE SO_DATE_FMT = '' END
* Get Ship Via SHIP_VIA = SO.REC<11>
* Count lines LINE_CODES = SO.REC<31> LINE_COUNT = DCOUNT(LINE_CODES, XVM) IF LINE_CODES = '' THEN LINE_COUNT = 0
* Sum qty QTY_LIST = SO.REC<35> TOTAL_QTY = 0 IF QTY_LIST NE '' THEN QTY_COUNT = DCOUNT(QTY_LIST, XVM) FOR QI = 1 TO QTY_COUNT QTY_VAL = QTY_LIST<1,QI> IF NUM(QTY_VAL) THEN TOTAL_QTY = TOTAL_QTY + QTY_VAL NEXT QI END
* Sanitize fields for XML FIELD_VALUE = SO_ID GOSUB CLEAN_XML_FIELD SAFE_SO_ID = FIELD_VALUE
FIELD_VALUE = SHIPTO_CODE GOSUB CLEAN_XML_FIELD SAFE_SHIPTO_CODE = FIELD_VALUE
FIELD_VALUE = SHIPTO_NAME GOSUB CLEAN_XML_FIELD SAFE_SHIPTO_NAME = FIELD_VALUE
FIELD_VALUE = SHIP_VIA GOSUB CLEAN_XML_FIELD SAFE_SHIP_VIA = FIELD_VALUE
FIELD_VALUE = SO_DATE_FMT GOSUB CLEAN_XML_FIELD SAFE_SO_DATE = FIELD_VALUE
FIELD_VALUE = CREDIT_HOLD GOSUB CLEAN_XML_FIELD SAFE_CREDIT_HOLD = FIELD_VALUE
* Build XML entry XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : SAFE_SO_ID : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : SAFE_SHIPTO_CODE : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : SAFE_SHIPTO_NAME : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : SAFE_SHIP_VIA : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : LINE_COUNT : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : TOTAL_QTY : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : SAFE_SO_DATE : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : SAFE_CREDIT_HOLD : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : CRLF REPEAT
XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : CNT : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : OFFSET : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : MAX_RESULTS : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : HAS_MORE : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : (OFFSET + CNT) : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : SCRIPT_VERSION : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : TOTAL_SELECTED : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : STATUS_SKIP_COUNT : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : SEARCH_SKIP_COUNT : '' : CRLF XML.RESPONSE = XML.RESPONSE : '' : CRLF
WRITE XML.RESPONSE ON XMLDATAF, 'GET_PENDING_SO_FAST.XML' ERR = '' CALL PLW.PAGE('/XMLDATA/GET_PENDING_SO_FAST.XML', '', ERR) RETURN
CLEAN_XML_FIELD: FOR CH = 0 TO 8 CONVERT CHAR(CH) TO '' IN FIELD_VALUE NEXT CH CONVERT CHAR(11) TO '' IN FIELD_VALUE CONVERT CHAR(12) TO '' IN FIELD_VALUE FOR CH = 14 TO 31 CONVERT CHAR(CH) TO '' IN FIELD_VALUE NEXT CH CONVERT CHAR(252):CHAR(253):CHAR(254):CHAR(255) TO '' IN FIELD_VALUE LOOP WHILE INDEX(FIELD_VALUE, '&', 1) > 0 DO FIELD_VALUE = FIELD(FIELD_VALUE, '&', 1) : '&' : FIELD(FIELD_VALUE, '&', 2, 9999) REPEAT LOOP WHILE INDEX(FIELD_VALUE, '<', 1) > 0 DO FIELD_VALUE = FIELD(FIELD_VALUE, '<', 1) : '<' : FIELD(FIELD_VALUE, '<', 2, 9999) REPEAT LOOP WHILE INDEX(FIELD_VALUE, '>', 1) > 0 DO FIELD_VALUE = FIELD(FIELD_VALUE, '>', 1) : '>' : FIELD(FIELD_VALUE, '>', 2, 9999) REPEAT RETURN
